correctness.rationale: For fixed a>0, the even simple sinc-operator ground state psi has spectral gap. The exact commutator (lambda0-K)(x psi)=(c/pi)sin(pi x) proves c!=0 and Q=<x psi,(lambda0-K)x psi>>0 on the odd subspace. Cross block B_R has O(R^-1) norm. At R=m+t/m, uniformly for bounded t, its expansion is (-1)^m[-S/(pi m)+(t C-D/pi)/m^2]+O(m^-3); the isolated double-eigenvalue Schur/Feshbach reduction has zero first-order projection, diagonal Q and off-diagonal (-1)^m(C_a t-2Q). This gives the two ordered eigenvalues lambda0+[Q +/- |C_a t-2Q|]/m^2+O(m^-3); nonresonant first-order splitting C_a|sin(pi R)|/(pi R)+O(R^-2). Even at t=2Q/C_a only leading cancellation, not exact degeneracy. Independent Gauss-Legendre Nyström check (a=.9,n=70) yielded lambda0≈.7352709208, C≈.46589650294, Q≈.03275270347 and m=20/40 errors consistent with the stated O(m^-3). These checks corroborate, not prove, uniform asymptotics.
